title: Vize lib lockfile
description: vize-lib.lock.json written by `vize lib pull` / `update` / `remove`. Records which package version every pulled item came from and the SHA-256 of each file at pull time; those digests are the merge base that lets `vize lib status`, `diff`, and `update` separate local edits from upstream changes. Commit it next to the pulled sources.

items.description: Pulled items sorted by kind, then name.

package.description: npm package that published the pulled version.

version.description: Exact package version the files were pulled from.

contentHash.description: Registry contentHash of the pulled version.

dir.description: Project-relative POSIX directory the registry layout was copied into; every item of one kind shares it.

direct.description: true when requested by name; false when pulled only as a registry dependency (removed with its last dependent).

registryDependencies.description: Registry dependency closure at pull time.

files.description: Registry-relative file path -> SHA-256 of the upstream bytes at pull time.
